title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update (PC) — The Boeing 727-200 Is HERE + TriStar & SU-27!
description:
MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update (April 4, 2026) – Boeing 727 & iniBuilds TriStar Released!

The MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update for PC is finally here, and it is a massive week for classic trijets! Today we are diving into the "must-have" FlightSim Studio Boeing 727-200 and the legendary iniBuilds TriStar Airliner. Whether you want retro airline operations or the supersonic power of the DC Designs SU-27 Flanker, this Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 update has something for everyone.

We also cover the latest MSFS 2024 new liveries and control tuning packages to help you get the most out of these new MSFS marketplace addons.
✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 FlightSim Studio AG: Boeing 727-200 (classic trijet vibes—perfect for retro airline ops) 
🛫 DC Designs: DC Designs SU-27 Flanker (fast, loud, and built for fighter‑jet fun) 
🛫 iniBuilds: TriStar Airliner (widebody trijet goodness for your long-haul lineup) [flightsimulator.com]

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 HRSimYard: H125 US Law Enforcement Livery Pack (great for utility / patrol-style flying) 
🎨 RmStudios: NEW COCKPIT PA28 DAKOTA C185 (a quirky combo pack that stands out this week) 
🎨 iniBuilds: TriStar Airliner Asian Livery Pack (regional variety for your TriStar routes) 
🎨 iniBuilds: TriStar Airliner European Livery Pack (classic Euro flavor for the L‑1011 era) 
🎨 iniBuilds: TriStar Airliner North American Livery Pack (perfect for building a full NA schedule) [flightsimulator.com]
If you enjoyed the update, drop a like, subscribe for weekly Marketplace coverage, and comment below—what are you picking up first: the 727, the TriStar, or the Flanker? 👇

Thanks for watching and happy flying
✈️ See you in the skies!
